title: Design System: Matthew Martin — Product Designer Portfolio

display.purpose: Page-level titles, light weight, colored as secondary gray for a soft first impression.

label.purpose: The system's structural voice: H3/H4, nav links, metadata, tags, footer text, CTA links.

body.purpose: Paragraph text, capped at a 65ch measure.

mono.purpose: Inline code and code blocks only.

shadows.name: shadow-nav
shadows.purpose: Soft ambient lift under the sticky, frosted nav bar.

shadows.name: shadow-image
shadows.purpose: Soft ambient shadow under article figures/photography only.

motion.name: t-medium
motion.purpose: Underline growth, arrow translation, back-link hover.

components.name: CTA Link
components.description: The system's stand-in for a button: uppercase label text with a hover-sliding arrow.
components.css: .ds-cta-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-family: 'Lato', sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 900; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.15em; color: #595959; text-decoration: none; transition: opacity 200ms ease; } .ds-cta-link--primary { color: #4A4A4A; } .ds-cta-link:hover { opacity: 0.6; } .ds-cta-link__arrow { display: inline-block; transition: transform 300ms ease; } .ds-cta-link:hover .ds-cta-link__arrow { transform: translateX(5px); } .ds-cta-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4A4A4A; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; border: 1px solid rgba(45,45,45,0.15); text-decoration: none; color: inherit; transition: border-color 300ms ease; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: rgba(45,45,45,0.3); } .ds-card__image { aspect-ratio: 16/9; overflow: hidden; background: rgba(45,45,45,0.05); } .ds-card__image img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; transition: transform 500ms ease; } .ds-card:hover .ds-card__image img { transform: scale(1.03); } .ds-card__body { padding: 1.5rem; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; } .ds-card__meta { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 900; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.15em; color: #595959; } .ds-card__title { font-size: 1.2rem; font-weight: 300; color: #4A4A4A; } .ds-card__excerpt { font-size: 0.9rem; color: #595959; line-height: 1.6; } .ds-card__cta { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; margin-top: 0.75rem; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 900; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.15em; color: #4A4A4A; } .ds-card__cta-arrow { transition: transform 300ms ease; } .ds-card:hover .ds-card__cta-arrow { transform: translateX(5px); }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Uppercase nav link with a growing underline on hover/active; the active drawer link is the system's only use of Oxblood.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 900; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.15em; color: #4A4A4A; text-decoration: none; position: relative; } .ds-nav-link::after { content: ''; position: absolute; bottom: -4px; left: 0; width: 0; height: 1px; background-color: #4A4A4A; transition: width 300ms ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover::after { width: 100%; } .ds-nav-link--active { color: #B03030; } .ds-nav-link--active::after { width: 100%; background-color: #B03030; }

components.name: Tag
components.description: Unfilled, unrounded tag/skill chip — border darkens on hover, no background fill.
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-block; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 900; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.15em; color: #595959; padding: 0.25em 0.6em; border: 1px solid #737373; transition: border-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-tag:hover { color: #4A4A4A; border-color: #4A4A4A; }

narrative.overview: The system reads as a design director's own portfolio typeset like a well-edited magazine, not assembled from a UI kit: light-weight display type carries the ideas, black-weight uppercase micro-labels carry structure and metadata, and everything else stays quiet enough to let the work and the writing lead. There are no filled buttons anywhere on the site; every call to action is a plain text link with a small arrow glyph that slides on hover. Cards and list items are defined by a single 1px border, never a shadow. The one saturated color (Oxblood) is reserved for exactly one job: marking the current/active nav state, nowhere else.
keyCharacteristics: Light-weight (300) display type at a wide scale (48–96px H1) against black-weight (900) uppercase micro-labels
Thin 1px borders instead of shadows for nearly everything; shadow reserved for sticky nav and article imagery only
No filled buttons — every action is a text link + arrow that translates on hover
Opacity-based hover feedback on cards and list rows rather than color or elevation changes
Contrast-tuned automatic dark mode implemented per-token, not a blanket invert

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Oxblood exists to answer one question — where am I right now in the nav — and nothing else. It never appears on a CTA, heading, card, or hover state.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Structure is drawn with 1px hairline borders, not elevation. The only two shadows (shadow-nav, shadow-image) are named exceptions, not general permission to add more.

rules.name: The Two-Weight Rule
rules.body: Only 300 (light, reading/headlines) and 900 (black, labels/structure) appear in normal use; 400 and 700 exist but are used sparingly rather than as a third visual register.

dos: Do build every new interactive element as a text link + arrow (cta-link pattern), not a filled or outlined button.
Do use a 1px hairline border for structure; reserve shadow strictly for nav and article imagery.
Do keep new headings/labels on the existing two-weight system.
Do preserve and extend the existing per-token contrast-tuned dark mode.
donts: Don't introduce Oxblood anywhere except the active nav-drawer state.
Don't add a filled button, badge, or pill-shaped element.
Don't add a third font-weight register for everyday use.
Don't carry forward styles.css / colors_and_type.css or their token files as sources of truth — they're superseded by stylesgem.css / tokens-stylesgem.json and already drift from it.
